Rich.Table.signature: Table(*headers, title=None, caption=None, width=None, min_width=None, box=None, safe_box=None, padding=(0, 1), collapse_padding=False, pad_edge=True, expand=False, show_header=True, show_footer=False, show_edge=True, show_lines=False, leading=0, style='none', row_styles=None, header_style='table.header', footer_style='table.footer', border_style=None, title_style=None, caption_style=None, title_justify='center', caption_justify='center', highlight=False)
Rich.Table.description: A console renderable that draws tabular data with optional borders, headers, footers, and per-column styling.[reference:5]

*headers.description: Column headers passed positionally. Strings create a default Column; Column instances are used directly.[reference:6]

width.description: Fixed total width in characters. Setting this implies expand=True.[reference:9]

box.description: Box drawing style for the table grid. Set to None to remove all box characters.[reference:11]

safe_box.description: If True, replaces box characters that are unsafe on legacy Windows terminals.[reference:12]

padding.description: Cell padding in CSS-style: 1, 2, or 4 integers (top, right, bottom, left).[reference:13]

collapse_padding.description: If True, merges adjacent padding between cells.[reference:14]

pad_edge.description: If True, applies padding to the leftmost and rightmost columns.[reference:15]

expand.description: If True, stretches the table to fill the available width.[reference:16]

show_header.description: If True, renders the header row.[reference:17]

show_footer.description: If True, renders the footer row.[reference:18]

show_edge.description: If True, renders the outer border.[reference:19]

show_lines.description: If True, draws horizontal lines between every data row.[reference:20]

leading.description: Number of blank lines between rows. Takes precedence over show_lines.[reference:21]

style.description: Default style applied to the entire table.[reference:22]

row_styles.description: Alternating row styles applied in order for striped rows.[reference:23]

title_style.description: Style for the title text. Falls back to 'table.title'.[reference:27]

caption_style.description: Style for the caption text. Falls back to 'table.caption'.[reference:28]

title_justify.description: Justification for the title (left, center, right, or full).[reference:29]

highlight.description: If True, applies the console highlighter to string cell contents.[reference:31]

add_column.signature: add_column(header, *, footer=None, style=None, justify='left', vertical='top', overflow='ellipsis', width=None, min_width=None, max_width=None, ratio=None, no_wrap=False, highlight=False)
add_column.description: Adds a column to the table with the given header and optional styling.[reference:32]

add_row.description: Adds a row of cells to the table. Cells can be any RenderableType.[reference:33]

grid.signature: grid(*headers, padding=0, collapse_padding=True, pad_edge=False, expand=False) -> Table
grid.description: Alternative constructor that returns a table pre-configured as a grid (no headers, borders, or padding).[reference:34]
